subject.title: feat(subagents): native announceTarget for subagent completion routing (#27445)

question: Should native `sessions_spawn` permanently expose an opt-in `announceTarget: "parent"` mode that wakes the requester with `deliver:false` and never falls back to direct channel delivery?
rationale: The implementation can be reviewed mechanically, but whether an agent-facing tool should offer silent fail-closed completion routing—and whether losing the completion is preferable to channel fallback—is a product and orchestration-policy choice.

options.title: Approve per-spawn parent routing
options.body: Accept the narrow opt-in parameter with the existing parent-first default and durable no-channel-fallback semantics.

options.title: Require observable fallback policy
options.body: Keep the capability but require an explicit failure notification, retry contract, or separately approved fallback behavior before merge.

options.title: Defer the capability
options.body: Leave the canonical feature request open but close or pause this implementation until silent parent routing is sponsored.

recommendation.title: Approve per-spawn parent routing
recommendation.body: Accept the narrow opt-in parameter with the existing parent-first default and durable no-channel-fallback semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: The current parent-first delivery behavior appears to originate in their work on the central subagent announcement path, making them the strongest available owner for the permanent routing contract.
